notes.TWN: 國發會《臺灣2050淨零排放路徑及策略總說明》（2022 年）：2040 年所有新售小客車與機車都是電動車（2030 年市售比 30%、35%，2035 年 60%、70%），2030 年市區公車與公務車全面電動化。交通部的行動計畫說明這是靠補貼達成的市售比目標，不是禁售或禁買燃油車

notesEn.NOR: Norway set a target in 2017 of selling no new combustion-engine cars from 2025 (a target, not a ban); by 2022 nearly nine in ten new cars sold were electric
notesEn.ETH: Ethiopia banned imports of combustion-engine vehicles in 2024
notesEn.USA: No federal phase-out date; about a dozen states that follow California's zero-emission vehicle rules set 2035 for all new cars to be zero-emission
notesEn.TWN: National Development Council, Taiwan's 2050 net-zero pathway (2022): all new cars and motorcycles sold from 2040 are to be electric (sales shares of 30% and 35% in 2030, 60% and 70% in 2035), with city buses and government cars fully electric by 2030. The transport ministry's action plan says this is a sales-share target reached through subsidies, not a ban on selling or buying combustion vehicles
